independence.priorAnnotationsRead: Only evaluation/{sites,blind-v2/sites,blind-v3/sites,blind-v4/sites}/*.json for exclusion and schema. No src/, tests/, dist/, product implementation, prior evaluation result, docs/RUN* or product execution.
independence.computerUse: No native UI automation, visible browser or user app changes. All browser work was headless.
independence.safety: Anonymous public GET/HEAD only. Non-GET/HEAD browser requests aborted. No user input values, input entry, authentication, form submission, download activation, original link click, original task handlers or actual business action.

selectionPolicy: Previously unseen source page URLs; representative main-content feature clusters selected from rendered page function and source context, not keyword/classifier output. Every included reconstructive control has accepted annotation. This small purposive page sample is not an estimate for all Korean websites.

categoryDefinitions.help: help, FAQs, safety instructions and service-use guidance

limitations: Small selected-control reconstructions, no full-page layout, source CSS/media or application scripts. Original selected-control labels, href/target, ancestor tags/classes/IDs and nearby fixed context are retained.
Source visible checks establish nonzero boxes and absence of CSS hiding/inert/aria-hidden; only one designated task control per page received read-only focus and center hit testing.

Source accessibility is actual Chromium AX data, and Playwright ariaSnapshot is additionally stored where its selector injection works. NL uses a CDP isolated world due a source-page conflict in Playwright selector injection. No site security, authentication or certificate settings were changed.
Task evidence is source control reach and safe public destination GET only. No actual extension toolbar installation or classifier execution was performed by the annotator.
Category coverage is academic, apply and help for these main-content pages; this new holdout is not balanced over all six product categories.
